card.name: Scattered general web text words
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires weakly on assorted commas, nouns like tab, biography and title, and sentence-starting words in general web prose.
card.plain: It responds to a mix of unrelated words in ordinary web text, and no recognizable pattern was found.
